description.value: Dickinson Family Farm is an RV campground set within a cherry orchard in Summerland, offering U-pick cherries across six varieties each July. The sites sit among the trees in a quiet, green setting with no concrete — a contrast to typical campgrounds. Touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan during cherry season can pick fruit directly from the trees alongside RV guests.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an RV campground with a cherry orchard offering U-pick cherries in July — not a grocery store. The OSM 'shop=farm' and 'self_harvesting=yes' tags align with the website's U-pick cherry service. The website explicitly mentions a clean outhouse (washroom) and drinking water at each campsite, but neither is framed as a service for passing cyclists. Several subpages contain lorem ipsum placeholder text, suggesting an incomplete website. The OSM community tag says Naramata but the website repeatedly states Summerland.
concerns: Community mismatch: OSM tags community as 'Naramata' but the website repeatedly identifies the location as Summerland ('Conveniently located in Summerland', '5 minutes from downtown').
Category mismatch: business is primarily an RV campground, not a grocery store; cherry U-pick is seasonal (July only).

Multiple subpages (/services/pick-your-own-delicious-cherries/, /services/a-true-orchard-experience/, /services/conveniently-located-in-summerland/, /services/pick-your-own-cherries/) contain lorem ipsum placeholder text, indicating an incomplete website.
No phone number or street address explicitly confirmed on the website; OSM values could not be cross-checked.
No mention of bike parking, bike rack, or any cyclist-specific amenity on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is an RV campground with seasonal U-pick cherries (July only), making it a poor fit for the Groceries category and of limited utility to touring cyclists outside cherry season. A reviewer should confirm whether the listing belongs in a Camping or Farm Stand category instead, and whether it meets minimum cyclist-service criteria.
enrichment_extras.notes: Water and power are available at RV campsites, but these are not offered as services to drop-in visitors. The outhouse washroom may be campsite-guest-only; not confirmed as publicly accessible.

provenance.category_correction_reason: This is primarily an RV campground with seasonal U-pick cherries (July only), not a grocery store. 'Farm Stand' or 'Camping' would better reflect the business. The OSM tag 'shop=farm' with 'self_harvesting=yes' is accurate but the Groceries directory category is a poor fit for most of the year.
